metadata.othernotes:
Lot of notes in this one, but good to read if you are a character developer wanting to target Angela with dialogue.

When playing against both a male and female player, if the other female player reveals her breasts, Angela will typically reveal her breasts the next time she loses a round (assuming, of course, she hasn't already), though she'll pretend that she's removing whatever she'd otherwise remove at that point. She won't do this if there are no men present, and it's not applicable if there are no other women. In a general sense, other characters should already acknowledge this without any further work, but if you want to give more specific reactions, read futher.

Please do NOT assume Angela's clothing status based solely on her stage! You can check her status (ie. "Chest visible") or the "AngelaEarlyBoobs" marker to be sure of which track she's on, and when she's stripping you can check which item she's removing. For example, if you want to have someone comment on Angela removing her gloves, it could be the transition from stage 2 to 3 as the metadata implies, or it could be the transition from stage 3 to 4 if she did the early chest reveal. The system will always report that she is removing her gloves either way.

Also: the system will report that she's removing the next article she would normally reveal in the "Stripping" phase when she is about to reveal her chest early - this is intentional behavior, and fits with Angela's actions and dialogue. So check for the "AboutToShowBoobs" marker, if for some reason you want a character to react just before she does the early reveal (for example, if your character is psychic, or just wants to react to Angela's fishy behavior). In the "After stripping" phase, the system will accurately report which item was removed.

Some characters get special treatment in regards to this gimmick:

* She believes Lucina and Mulan are male until they reveal themselves to be women (she gets quite annoyed if she gets topless early, only to find out they're the only "men" in the game!)
* Similarly, she believes that Chihiro is female before he's naked. However, when Chihiro becomes topless, he runs off, so Chihiro cannot trigger the early reveal.
* Since Pandoria strips alongside him, if Zeke is topless she'll reveal herself (almost) no matter who else is playing.
* If Angela witnesses Tharja shrinking another woman's breasts, she'll chicken out so as not to incur Tharja's wrath.
* She's doing this to tease the men. If she realizes that all men at the table are gay before doing the early breast reveal, she won't do it. She will usually pick up on this around the time another woman gets topless.
* I mention Sanny and Tess only to pre-empt people asking about them: she automatically treats them as female for the sake of this gimmick, and I did not include any checks to change this.

She isn't terribly concerned with showing her breasts, though the lack of an early flash if there are no other topless women indicates that she might not be quite as comfortable with it as she pretends. She is a bit more concerned about showing more than her breasts. Keep in mind: though she's not opposed to stealing glances at the men, and despite her flirty behavior, she's playing to win, not to strip without a fight, and definitely not to have sex with the other players. (Maybe if Duran was playing...)

When targeting Angela, some of her cases are marked with "SWITCH CASE TYPE TO 'OPPONENT STRIPPING/STRIPPED'". After writing the line, please find it under "Removing Accessory (female)" or "Removed Accessory (female)" and switch its case type as suggested. For reference: The first problem is that these are multi-stage situations, but the character editor naively assumes that she's removing an accessory because that's what her first stage has her do. The second problem is that, well, she's not actually removing an accessory when these cases are relevant!

As for her dialogue, some artistic license was taken. She talks about her adventure as something that took place in the past, but at the end of her game, mana disappears from her world, so she should not be able to cast magic. This is ignored for this game, as she summons elementals and talks about magic as though it is a thing she is still capable of casting. She mentions Dragonsmaw and being possessed by a faerie*, indicating she was the main character for her "run" through the game. She goes on to mention all of her possible companions when applicable, Duran in particular, but never indicates which ones accompanied her on her journey.

(Should other Trials of Mana characters be introduced later, it is fair for them to talk as though they were the main character when Angela is not present, but if she is, then either it should be established that they're from alternate timelines, or one of the two should stop talking as though they're the main character and defer to the other.)

In future versions, her Omen Book collectible will unlock her Magus outfit, but that hasn't been made yet. The Omen Book collectible is not yet enabled for online play for this very reason.

Oh, and for those wondering: though elves exist in "Trials of Mana", Angela is not one. Humans with pointy ears just seem to exist in the World of Mana series (for example, Primm of Secret of Mana has them too).

* - In Trials of Mana, the word is always spelled "faerie". Angela's dialogue follows suit.
